packageRules.description: Immutable-ref housekeeping (pin, pinDigest) automerges. Digest, patch and minor updates also automerge, through the org's inherited rules, once checks pass; nothing here holds them for a person.

Third-party GitHub Actions (everything except first-party projectbluefin/**) automerge only once their release is three days old, so a compromised release has time to be spotted and pulled upstream before it lands here. Same decision as finpilot#645. First-party projectbluefin/** actions are not delayed.

Give action bumps in the three release workflows their own pull request. The hive lets a trusted bot merge a pure pin bump to these files without a person (its pin-only exception), but only when every file in the pull request is one of them; grouped with other workflows, as in #1127, the bump always waits for a person.
KDE runner image and Python requirements
Keep the VM jobs on Ubuntu 24.04: bootc's loopback install fails on 26.04 runners (#1123, #1131). Drop this once the install works there.
A major update always waits for a person. Last matching rule wins, so keep this rule last.
